    Encryption has a boundary.
    Know what’s outside it

    A prototype. Not a promise.

    This is an unaudited composition of a Noise NNpsk0 handshake and libsodium secretstream records. Use an established audited messenger for sensitive conversations.

    Devices still matter. Malicious delivered code, extensions, your OS, organizational monitoring and the recipient may see plaintext. This app does not measure endpoint integrity.

    The relay still sees metadata. Connection IPs, room association, roles, timing and message-size buckets remain visible. Encryption is not anonymity. This version uses a local WebSocket relay, not WebRTC P2P or TURN.

    Clearing is local and best effort. No app history, telemetry or plaintext is deliberately persisted. Clearing stops the worker and removes this transcript; it cannot erase copies, screenshots, clipboard history, swap or browser/OS memory. No forensic zeroization or post-compromise recovery is promised.

    Local only. HTTP/WS is restricted to loopback. Do not expose this server to a LAN or the internet. The invite is stripped from the URL after import, but sharing apps or browser history may already have retained it.

    Clear this device?

    This closes the session and removes this transcript. It cannot erase your peer’s copies or browser/OS remnants.
